scope: Whole-product concept preserving all capabilities below

pages.label: Monitoring
pages.purpose: Observe selected chambers and investigate conditions

pages.label: Schedules
pages.purpose: List, create and edit thermal schedules; inspect the next run

pages.label: People
pages.purpose: List people, inspect their assigned chamber scopes and assign existing roles

pages.label: Roles
pages.purpose: List actual roles and edit permitted role names and grants

commands.label: Refresh readings
commands.effect: Refetch readings without changing the selected chambers, history interval or display preferences

commands.label: Copy view link
commands.effect: Copy selection and current history instant; does not create a saved object

commands.label: Rename view
commands.effect: Edit selected saved view name; explicit Save and Cancel; preserve old name until Save

commands.label: Reset arrangement
commands.effect: Restore default ordering; Undo available within the current session

viewSelector.changingValue: Restore that view's chamber selection and ordering; retain personal display choices

threshold.rule: Preview an event when a new sample is at least the upper threshold

perChamber.interaction: Select a trace to inspect its exact sample value and time without hiding the other traces

statistics.summaryInspector: Aggregate selected chambers, retain selection and time alignment; independent of on-chamber metrics
statistics.combinations: All display booleans can be chosen independently; chamber metrics, summary inspector and messenger can remain visible together

events.previewAnchor: lower start edge of monitoring workspace
events.overflow: Show count and an entry to event history
events.expiry: 12 seconds; pause while hovered or keyboard-focused
events.dismissal: Dismiss one preview without dismissing others or acknowledging the incident
events.persistence: History retains events after preview expiry

messenger.draftRule: Retain recipient selection and unsent text across panel changes, closing and mode changes
messenger.scope: Independent of selected chamber; in docked mode setup and editing remain within the messenger region

permissions.roleActions: List roles, inspect grants, create a custom role, edit custom role name/grants; system role is inspectable but not editable
permissions.scopeRule: Role grants intersect assigned chamber scope; managing people does not imply threshold editing
